Application Security

एपीआई रेट लिमिटिंग

A security control mechanism that restricts the number of API requests from a user or client within a specified timeframe to prevent abuse, denial-of-service, and brute-force attacks.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

A security control mechanism that restricts the number of API requests from a user or client within a specified timeframe to prevent abuse, denial-of-service, and brute-force attacks.

Operational example

API Rate Limiting must be configured to block excessive requests and generate alerts when thresholds are exceeded, protecting backend resources.
